audience: teams managing electronic signatures and documents with OKSign

useCases.title: Review documents awaiting signatures
useCases.text: List active documents and inspect their form descriptors to review required signature fields and the current signature counts.

useCases.title: Review recently signed documents
useCases.text: List documents signed within a time window and inspect a signed document’s metadata, including its signature counts and completed field values.

useCases.title: Add or update signing contacts
useCases.text: Review the contact list and add or update named contacts when requested. The update preserves the rest of the contact list.

useCases.title: Review delivery errors and account credits
useCases.text: Inspect email or SMS delivery problems for a time window and check the account’s remaining credits and storage.
